title: Predict seagrass habitats (kriging + presence-only MaxEnt)
output_type: vector (training features) + raster (global prediction) + intermediate rasters
required_outputs: trainfeatures2.shp (any point vector with explanatory values)
method: EPSG:8857. Dissolve USA_seagrass; 5 000 random points inside (seed 0). Ordinary kriging (open substitute for EBK) of temp and salinity from 33 196 points: linear semivariogram fitted to lags <= 1 000 km, 50 nearest neighbours, 25 km grid over Global_shallow_waters + USA_shallow_waters. Presence-only model = infinitely weighted logistic regression (MaxEnt equivalent): presence thinned at 2 km inside USA_shallow_waters (3 280), background = 25 km study-area cells (1 949, weight 100), linear/quadratic/product/hinge features, cloglog output; global prediction over shallow waters.
benchmark_defects: Empirical Bayesian Kriging and ArcGIS Presence-only Prediction have no open-source equivalent; the checks accept open-source substitutes (ordinary kriging or Gaussian-process regression; maxnet or a presence-background GLM).
The study-area/mask roles of USA_shallow_waters and Global_shallow_waters are only implied; 13 % of the seagrass area lies outside USA_shallow_waters.

Random points at 2 km thinning on 25 km rasters give many presence points per cell (pseudo-replication); the original's random 3-group CV is optimistic (reference: random AUC 0.815 vs 500 km spatial-block AUC 0.751).
Global prediction extrapolates far outside the US training range (tropical waters), which the original explicitly allows.
checks: required: a point set of 4 000-5 100 presence points (the instruction asks for 5 000) >= 97 % inside the dissolved seagrass (1 km tolerance)
required: a saved training point file whose temperature / salinity columns agree with the gold kriged surfaces at the points (Pearson >= 0.8 / 0.6)

required: a georeferenced prediction raster covering >= 80 % of the gold prediction cells whose centre lies inside Global_shallow_waters with Spearman >= 0.5 to the gold probability (rasters that reproduce a kriged explanatory surface, |Spearman| >= 0.95 with the gold kriged temperature or salinity, are not candidates)
optional: spatial CV or thinning mentioned
required: prediction depends on both temperature and salinity (joint-bin rank R2 >= 0.5, gain >= 0.05 over each single variable)

required (the instruction prescribes EBK): kriging-type interpolation in the code (comments removed) - pykrige OK/UK, gstools, GP regression, a *krig*/*ebk*/*vario*() call, or a hand-rolled kriging (fitted variogram/covariance model + linear-system solve); IDW / nearest / RBF / ML regression fail
required (the instruction prescribes MaxEnt): presence-only MaxEnt-type model - maxnet / elapid / maxent*() or a presence-vs-background logistic/Poisson GLM (IWLR); random forest / boosting fail
